name: audio_keepalive
description: Maintains continuous audio output to prevent HDMI/SPDIF/USB signal loss during idle
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Keeps the output open so HDMI receivers, SPDIF decoders and USB DACs do not drop lock when idle. Music passes through unchanged; inaudible noise is written only while nothing plays.
volumio_info.changelog: v2.1.3: Keeps the audio output open so HDMI receivers, S/PDIF decoders and USB DACs do not drop lock while nothing plays: a daemon owns the output and writes inaudible noise only while idle; music passes through unchanged and without gaps, paced to the device, and nothing queued is lost on pause, stop or a short device write.
